concept: Taking initiative and leading when no one else will step up
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.scenario: Student is in a group situation (project, event, crisis moment) where no one is taking charge and something needs to happen
exercise.branching_choice: Student decides whether and how to step into the gap
exercise.practice: Socratic follow-up on what held others back and what made stepping up possible

assessment.success_marker: student identifies a specific reason others hesitated, and a specific way they could step in constructively
